evidence.reason: The finding asked that the round-1 admission gate also cover `lease.expectedHead` rather than letting an unconditional lease spread override it from round 2 on. At the pinned tip the code already implements exactly that: `const roundOneExpectedHead = round === 1 ? (lease.expectedHead ?? input.expectedHead) : undefined;` (lines 2974-2975), passed as `...(roundOneExpectedHead ? { expectedHead: roundOneExpectedHead } : {})` (line 2983). The unconditional `...(lease.expectedHead ? { expectedHead: lease.expectedHead } : {})` spread the finding targets is gone, and the comment at lines 2971-2973 explains the admission-only rationale for later rounds. The requested change is present, so the finding no longer holds against the current contract.
